tomb-world.json: world-space collision triangle fixture derived from Tutankhamun+tomb+with+sarcophagus by akurtulus, https://skfb.ly/ouRUN, licensed CC BY 4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Transform scale 0.0254; modern figure excluded; duplicate faces removed. Generate with python3 scripts/audit-tomb-geometry.py --write-fixture from assets/egypt/walkthrough/tomb.glb.
